nodes.label: Vigil Reels Blocked Screen
nodes.rationale: Full-screen mobile interstitial shown when the student opens reels or shorts. Dark warm-brown gradient, Mayu centered with a red exclamation mark, a bold headline, a guilt-trip message card that names the student's own exam goal, and a single amber 'Back to studying' button. The only way out is back to work.

nodes.label: Mayu the Peacock Mascot
nodes.rationale: Cute cartoon blue peacock whose expression changes with context (alarmed here, sleepy on Home, fierce in a session). Gives the app a personality, so the blocking feels like a friend's nudge, not a punishment.

nodes.label: Reels & Shorts Blocking
nodes.rationale: Short-form video is blocked outright ('Reels & shorts are blocked'), not just time-limited.

nodes.label: Personal Goal Reminder ("You said: Top 100 in IPMAT Indore")
nodes.rationale: Quotes the student's own stated goal back to them ('Imagine explaining to IPMAT Indore that you watched reels instead'). Uses commitment and accountability rather than a generic warning.

nodes.label: Back to Studying Button
nodes.rationale: Single amber primary action with no dismiss or override option shown. Keeps the student from bargaining their way past the block.

hyperedges.label: Distraction blocking: rules -> reels blocked screen -> blocked counter -> rule-break stats
